items.title: Rollback Does Not Erase Distributed Memory
Atlassian Rebuilds Metrics Pipeline Around OpenTelemetry at Massive Scale
items.blurb: Software company Atlassian has published an account of its migration from gostatsd to OpenTelemetry, replacing the internal workings of a metrics platform that receives data from about 100,000 hosts across 14 regions.

items.title: Kubernetes Teams Get a Safer Way to See Their Own GPU Metrics
items.blurb: Adobe engineers have described an open-source approach for giving teams self-service access to their own Prometheus metrics in multi-tenant Kubernetes environments, without exposing the shared metrics of other teams. By Craig Risi

items.title: Cloudflare Worker Previews: Per-Branch Environments for Workers
items.blurb: Cloudflare has introduced Worker Previews. This feature allows each Git branch to have its own isolated, production-like environment for a Worker. Each environment has a stable URL.
